jobs.occupation: Top Pastry Chef – Specialised in Wagashi
jobs.description:
Location: Antwerp, Belgium 

 
Languages: English & Spanish
 

About the role
 We are looking for an exceptional pastry talent — someone who blends the refinement of 
Japanese wagashi with the expressive flavours of 
South America. As our Top Pastry Chef, you’ll create desserts that merge tradition, craftsmanship, and innovation into a unique culinary identity.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

•  

Develop and perfect desserts inspired by Japanese wagashi techniques.
  

•  

Integrate South American flavours and textures into innovative pastry concepts.
  

•  

Collaborate closely with chefs and product development teams to bring ideas to life.
  

•  

Ensure top-level quality, presentation, and consistency across all creations.
  

•  

Mentor and inspire junior pastry chefs.
   

Your profile
 
 

•  

2+ years experience in high end pastry
  

•  

At least 
6 months of training or work experience in Japan, ideally in wagashi or traditional Japanese pastry.
  

•  

Proven experience working in or with South American culinary traditions.
  

•  

Strong aesthetic sense and technical mastery; storytelling through flavour.
  

•  

Fluent in 
English and Spanish; Japanese language skills are a plus.
  

•  

Creative, detail-oriented, and passionate about merging cultures through pastry.
   

What we offer
 
 

•  

A unique opportunity to shape your signature within an international high-end concept.
  

•  

Artistic freedom and room for culinary innovation.
  

•  

Competitive salary and growth potential within a creative, professional environment.

We are looking for an analytical and customer-focused Junior Technical Support Specialist to join our team and become the technical anchor for our clients. In this role you will support domain experts in model/AI risk management, model development, model validation,… who rely on us for complex product queries, custom configurations and bug resolution. This requires a deep understanding of our solutions and the ability to solve technical puzzles. You will take full ownership of client questions ensuring that users receive the right advice, can use the product effectively and have their issues resolved quickly and efficiently. As you master our platform and understand the different configurations of our clients, this role offers a clear growth path towards an implementation consultant or customer success account management role.
 

How you'll make an impact
 
 

• Take ownership of complex product inquiries, guiding our customers through technical challenges and platform usage via our service desk. 

• Adapt and adjust existing custom configurations tailored to the needs of our clients. 

• Create and maintain 
customer-facing support documentation and tutorial videos. 

• Thoroughly reproduce, verify and analyze reported bugs, resolving what you can and 
accurately translating issues for the product team. 

• Own the end-to-end communication for client issues, ensuring the user stays informed and guided even when an issue is escalated. 

• Build a deep 
understanding of each client’s specific setup to provide proactive support. 

• Collaborate closely with internal teams (product team, Information Security team) to ensure timely and high-quality support. 

What we're looking for
 
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Engineering, or a similar field, or equivalent experience in a similar role. 

• A customer-centric professional with 
excellent communication skills who genuinely enjoys helping experts solve complex problems. 

• Fluency in 
English ( 
spoken and written) is an absolute must. 

• Ability to translate business needs or functional problems into 
clear technical requirements. 

• A 
strong analytical mindset. You don’t just pass along an issue, you investigate the root cause and resolve the issue yourself or introduce short-term workarounds to unblock the client. 

• A strong affinity for 
complex enterprise SaaS software solutions combined with the eagerness to learn about MRM and AI governance. 

• Python skills are a plus. 

• Hands-on experience in database and SQL is a plus. 

• A high 
ownership mentality, taking full responsibility issues from the moment they are raised until the final solution is communicated. 

• An 
ambitious individual looking to grow into an implementation consultant expert or account manager role focused on deep product expertise.

Do you like working accurately and enjoy a practical job? For the same family-run logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for a packer who pays attention to detail and ensures that customer orders are processed correctly and efficiently.
 

What will you do?
 

- Check the quality and quantity of products before packing. 

- Carefully pack parts according to the required specifications. 

- Process orders based on instructions provided through a computer system or order form. 

- Handle parts weighing up to 10 kg.

- You speak and understand English. 

- You are comfortable with standing work and handling parts up to 10 kg. 

- You can work with a computer and process an order form accurately. 

- You are looking for a full-time position and work in a precise and structured way.

Do you enjoy variety and like to get things done? For a family-run logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for a versatile warehouse worker who can be flexibly deployed across different departments and enjoys taking on a variety of tasks.
 

What will you do?
 

- Assemble wooden crates for shipping large machine parts. 

- Pack parts manually and using machines. 

- Process and register documents and information in the computer system. 

- Support colleagues across different departments where needed.

- You enjoy combining physical work with administrative tasks and can easily switch between the two. 

- You speak and understand English well. 

- You work accurately, are flexible and have a hands-on mentality.

Do you enjoy working with metal and have an eye for detail?
 

We are looking for a Warehouse Operator for a company in Lokeren. 

You will be responsible for checking, preparing and processing returned metal machine components. You will work daytime hours in a technical working environment with a varied range of tasks.
 

What will you do?
 

- Sort and visually inspect returned metal machine components for defects. 

- Check technical drawings and verify that all parts are complete. 

- Carry out small tasks such as removing rust and touch-up painting. 

- Prepare parts for shipment. 

- Process and register parts using the internal computer system.

- You have an interest in mechanics and metalworking. 

- You work accurately and in a structured way, with an eye for detail. 

- You are comfortable working with computers and internal systems. 

- You are a hands-on team player and speak Dutch or English

Our client is a well-established global technology and manufacturing organization with over a century of industry expertise. The company develops innovative commercial equipment and intelligent embedded control systems used by businesses and institutions worldwide.

Jobomschrijving

• Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware using C programming for electronic control systems.
• Develop reliable and efficient software solutions for next-generation embedded products.
• Create and execute test plans and validation activities to ensure product quality and performance.
• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to validate firmware on prototypes and production units.
• Perform root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and debugging of firmware and hardware integration issues.
• Optimize communication and interaction between embedded systems, peripherals, and control components.
• Work extensively with embedded interfaces and peripherals, including UART, I2C, ADC, PWM, EEPROM, timers, and interrupts.
• Support new product development initiatives, feature enhancements, and product releases.
• Manage firmware revisions, documentation, and engineering change activities.
• Utilize source control and issue-management tools to support structured development practices.
• Provide technical support to manufacturing teams during pilot builds and production deployments.

To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Gift Petto on +66 2 012 5067.

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Minimum 7 years of experience in embedded firmware development.
• Strong proficiency in C programming for embedded systems.
• Hands-on experience working with microcontrollers and embedded communication protocols.
• Solid understanding of UART, I2C, ADC, PWM, EEPROM, interrupt handling, and timer-based applications.
• Proven experience in debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of embedded applications.
• Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
• Experience working with issue-tracking and software development lifecycle tools.
• Knowledge of test-driven development or structured software testing methodologies is an advantage.
• Ability to work effectively with international engineering teams and stakeholders.
• Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, and attention to detail.
• Good communication skills with the ability to work in English-speaking environments.

Your role
For one of our most prestigious clients in Brussels, we are looking for an Office & Reception Collaborator to take on a key hospitality and coordination role within the site.

You will work in an international and highly professional environment, welcoming and supporting a community that includes diplomatic members and high-level visitors.

This position goes beyond traditional reception duties. You will become a central point of contact for the floor, ensuring that daily operations run smoothly, events are properly coordinated and every visitor and member receives a consistently high level of hospitality.

The position represents 37 hours of work per week.
Your mission
Your first objective will be to develop an excellent understanding of the entire floor, its organisation, its community and its operating protocols.

As the position involves regular interaction with diplomatic members and visitors, professionalism, discretion and respect for established protocols are essential.

Together with your colleague on the floor, you will ensure the smooth coordination of daily activities and maintain a welcoming, organised and professional environment.
Your main responsibilities
• Welcome members, visitors and guests in a warm and professional manner
• Learn and follow the specific protocols and procedures applicable to the floor
• Coordinate and organise events, meetings and activities taking place on the floor
• Prepare and monitor meeting rooms and shared spaces
• Ensure that coffee machines and hospitality areas are operational, clean and properly supplied
• Coordinate daily operational and hospitality requirements
• Work closely with your floor colleague to ensure continuity and an effective distribution of responsibilities
• Anticipate needs and respond proactively to requests from members and visitors
• Coordinate with internal teams, suppliers and relevant service providers when required
• Follow up on existing community services, including access-related services, dry cleaning and other concierge services
• Support administrative tasks and maintain clear operational follow-up
• Contribute actively to creating a genuine sense of hospitality and community throughout the floorWorking schedule
This is a 37-hour-per-week position.

A standard working schedule will be established. However, flexibility is an important part of the role, as working hours may occasionally be adapted according to the client's needs, scheduled events and the level of activity on the floor.

We are therefore looking for someone who is comfortable working within a structured schedule while remaining flexible when operational needs require it.
 Your profile
For this position, we are looking for someone who combines excellent hospitality skills with strong organisational abilities.

You:

• Have a strong sense of hospitality and genuinely enjoy working with people
• Are highly organised, structured and able to manage several priorities
• Have good working knowledge of Microsoft Office
• Communicate professionally and confidently with different types of guests and stakeholders
• Understand the importance of discretion, confidentiality and professional conduct
• Are comfortable working in an international and diplomatic environment
• Are proactive and capable of identifying what needs to be done without always waiting for instructions
• Enjoy working as part of a two-person team while also being capable of working independently
• Are physically comfortable moving regularly throughout the floor during the working day
• Are flexible regarding working hours when events or operational requirements require adjustments
• Are eligible to meet the client's applicable security and background requirements
• Are available to start as soon as possibleLanguages
As you will be working in an international environment, strong language skills are essential:

• English is mandatory
• Fluency in at least one of Belgium's national languages - French, Dutch or German - is mandatory
• Knowledge of additional languages is highly appreciated and considered an asset
Previous experience in corporate reception, hospitality, front office, office support, events or workplace services is a strong asset.
 What we offer
We offer a fixed-term contract (CDD) of 37 hours per week, with the perspective of developing into a permanent contract (CDI).

You will join one of our most prestigious client environments and take on a position with real responsibility and visibility within the site.

You can also expect:

• A professional and international working environment
• A key role combining reception, office support, hospitality and event coordination
• A high level of autonomy and responsibility
• Close collaboration with another colleague on the floor
• The opportunity to build strong relationships with an international community
• A position where your ideas, initiative and organisational skills can make a real difference
• Salary and benefits in accordance with the applicable Belgian employment conditionsMore than a reception role
This position is ultimately about creating an experience.

Beyond supporting meetings, events and daily operations, your role is to make people feel welcome, supported and part of a community.

You will be one of the key people responsible for bringing hospitality, organisation and a human touch to the floor every day.
Ready to Join Ask Nestor?
If you are passionate about facilities, hospitality, and operational excellence, and you enjoy creating exceptional workplace experiences, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of the Ask Nestor team.

jobs.occupation: Join Our Team as an Order Picker Warehouse Associate – Start Immediately in a Dynamic Environment!
jobs.description:
As an order picker warehouse associate, you play a key role in the warehouse operation. You will operate a high-level order picker truck (VNA), allowing you to safely pick products from elevated racks. Using a handheld scanner, you accurately check locations, quantities, and the correctness of orders. Your effort ensures that customers receive the right products on time and keeps the logistics process running smoothly.

On a typical workday, you collect customer orders by picking products from various warehouse locations. You work closely with colleagues, strictly follow safety instructions, and keep your workspace clean. You check products for damage or missing items and report these to the team leader. Packing and preparing orders for shipment is also part of your tasks, ensuring everything is ready to go out to customers efficiently.

Are you physically fit, detail-oriented, and do you enjoy a varied job in logistics? Apply today and make a difference in a close-knit team where collaboration and safety are essential.

• Previous experience as an order picker or warehouse associate is a plus.
• Certificate of good conduct (criminal record certificate) required.
• License or certificate for high-level order picker truck is an advantage.
• English speaking skills at level 3/5 (for effective communication and understanding instructions).
• Good physical fitness: able to stand, walk, and lift up to 17 kg.
• Accurate, responsible, and able to work safely in a fast-paced environment.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company (re)packs and stores frozen and refrigerated food products for numerous European companies. They do this for each customer. By 2027, the company aims to have 300+ employees working on 25 000 unique packaging assignments. Working in this company means working in a respectful environment, where a great bond between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

As an operator, you will be responsible for 1 of 2 automatic packaging lines.

 
• 
You carry out checks on the food products that are introduced.

 
• 
You also set various parameters so that the right product ends up in the right packaging.

 
• 
Furthermore, you have to monitor the smooth operation of your packaging line.

 
• 
In case of technical failures, you are the first person who tries to solve this. For major malfunctions, you coordinate with the person in charge.

 
• 
The checks on the finished product are also done by you.

 
• 
All this in a team with a co-operator and 2 forklift drivers.

Read on quickly below and find out if you qualify:

 
• 
You have experience in setting up machines (it is a vertical packaging machine).

 
• 
You have a good technical knowledge.

 
• 
You speak good English and Dutch

 
• 
Experience as a forklift operator or forklift certificate is a plus.

 
• 
You highly value safety.

As a future butcher / deboner of pork meat, you will work on different lines with tasks such as cutting shoulders, bellies, and ribs. 

Experience is an asset, but motivated newcomers are welcome. 

Thanks to the Butchers Academy, you will receive comprehensive training, followed by a permanent contract and annual evaluations offering opportunities for advancement.

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.
